primaryObjective: Make explicit time-of-day evidence a typed, provenance-preserving Analysis assessment while keeping local clock text, uncertainty, and absent timezone semantics distinct.
hypothesis: At least 102,410 catalog rows across Majestic, MUFON, and UFOCAT can retain a typed local-clock evidence class without inferring timezone, solar state, or missing values, making a descriptive time-of-day assessment safely estimable.

inScope: immutable event-aligned time-of-day sidecar preserving original clock text and source role
typed exact-clock, approximate, range, qualitative, missing, invalid, and unresolved classes
source-era-region descriptive distributions and conservative common-support comparison
compact Time dashboard disclosure plus JSON and CSV evidence export
deterministic provenance, release, preview, production, and rollback receipts
outOfScope: solar, twilight, astronomical, or celestial correlation
coercing missing, midnight-like, noon-like, approximate, or invalid values to exact clock times
incidence, risk, authenticity, travel, facility, or causal claims
any assessment other than explicit time-of-day evidence

requiredFields: typed clock class and normalized minutes only when supported
estimators: source-era-region common-support standardized active/reference share difference
readinessContract.uncertaintyTreatment: Original clock text, time precision, approximation, qualitative periods, missing values, invalid formats, and timezone availability remain distinct. Unknown timezone is never inferred from coordinates or location text.
readinessContract.suppressionPolicy: Show readiness and descriptive failure counts instead of inferential comparisons whenever typed coverage, provenance integrity, common support, bin support, or stability gates fail. Never treat missing time as midnight or an unknown timezone as local solar time.

releaseGates: original clock preservation, timezone non-inference, and idempotence
exact, approximate, range, qualitative, missing, invalid, midnight, and noon tests
statistical determinism, common support, FDR isolation, and holdout stability
no timezone, solar-state, incidence, authenticity, or Pattern Finder promotion
Pages and R2 separation with immutable versioned R2 keys
desktop and mobile browser QA, keyboard, themes, reduced motion, exports, and zero console errors
identical frozen Pages package preview to production and tested rollback
stopConditions: fewer than 102410 rows retain typed time-of-day evidence without canonical repair
fewer than three sources retain at least 1000 typed rows
original clock text and normalized value cannot remain distinct
the assessment requires inferred timezone or solar state
rights or provenance cannot be resolved
performance or existing Analysis behavior regresses beyond release gates
